value.rationale: Exactly four collinear centers with a fifth off the baseline is the minimal mixed degeneracy outside both the generic and fully collinear ideal theorems. Localizing the quartic correction to one fifth-view point is structural information that can guide saturation, primary-decomposition, and local-equation analyses of mixed line-multiview ideals.
